findings.c3_impact: S21C3-036 offers every outcome to intake and S21C3-062 requires restart to re-resolve every counted outcome. A re-harvest after an interruption currently raises.
findings.contradicts: The module docstring states intake 'can be re-run after a crash without producing a second record'. That holds only when the clock is pinned, which the C1 tests do and production does not.
findings.observed: LearnedObservationIntake stamps recorded_at from its clock and LearnedObservationRecord is hash-bound, so offering the same governed outcome twice at different moments raises idempotency_key_reused instead of returning the existing record.
